comments.body:
Moved under #510 (the change delivery pipeline: propose, review, merge), in the loop intent #606, on 2026-10-29 (the product owner): what a landing review checks again is a question for the change plays, not for planning.

A second case, found today: plan 717 landing on main (PR #981) runs the full check-change again over PR #980's work, which check-change had already reviewed twice before it merged into plan/717/base. The landing review should check only what no earlier pull request reviewed.
Closed on 2026-10-29 (the product owner): its only story, #915 (what a plan's landing review checks again), moved under #510, the change delivery pipeline in the loop intent #606.
